## Investigation Report

### Verdict / Confidence / Severity / Task Type

| Field | Finding |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Valid bug with a partial staging implementation |
| Confidence | High |
| Severity | Medium — impossible required checks can still be authored or retained without an init-time repository-aware choice |
| Task Type | Verification policy, safe preflight, and init configuration |

### What Was Claimed

Issue #94 reports that a structurally valid required command such as root `npm test` can be accepted in a monorepo whose runnable test script exists only under `web/`. The failure is discovered after implementation instead of before any writer starts.

### What We Found

The staging tree already contains a safe `cwd` field, repository-relative path validation, and a static preflight called from `startIssue` before writer launch. The preflight correctly checks the frozen prepared base and reports policy paths for missing directories, executables, and package scripts.

The remaining lifecycle gap is `/forge:init`: it unconditionally serializes `verification.commands` as `{}`. That silently discards existing local checks and gives users no repository-aware way to select a package script. The only way to retain a local command is manual config editing, and command-manager syntax edge cases are not covered by the static preflight.

### Root Cause

Policy initialization has no local-verification decision or package-manifest discovery step. The policy parser and runtime binding know about `cwd`, but init does not use that capability. Existing commands are reset rather than preserved, and the preflight's script detector assumes every `bun test` invocation is a package script.

### Affected Files

| Path | Area |
| --- | --- |
| `src/ui/commands.ts` | `/forge:init` policy generation and user-facing remediation |
| `src/adapters/verification-preflight.ts` | Static command/package validation and safe manifest discovery |
| `src/core/policy.ts` | Existing validated `cwd` contract to preserve and exercise |
| `test/adapters/verification-preflight.test.ts` | Monorepo and command-manager regression coverage |
| `test/ui/commands.test.ts` | Init configuration behavior coverage |
| `README.md` | Document explicit CI-only/local package selection behavior |
